answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using interactive proof-of-inference challenges. Each agent authenticates by solving multimodal tasks, such as segmenting an onyx stone or parsing the meter of a sonnet, and broadcasting a signed execution signal. An adversary incurs inescapable GPU compute and electricity costs per fake identity. However, model distillation and quantization steadily erode this barrier, allowing attackers to emulate legitimate responses at minimal expense.
